description: Get a citation for a published paper (no auth). Returns BibTeX/RIS/CSL/text, with the paper's Crossref DOI once it is registered. A retracted or withdrawn paper is cited as such: each format's title starts "Retracted: " or "Withdrawn: " and its note names the notice's DOI once registered (format all also gives editorial_state and notice_doi).
name: cite_paper
title: Cite a published paper
